## Report and scope

Source: https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/issues/1202

Reproduce receipt lifecycle after an aborted rebase and distinguish an abandoned candidate from a merge requiring review. Current source and Merge Safety documentation intentionally track privacy-safe durable sidecars; raw free-form retained/discarded values are clone-local under .git. Durable receipts retain hashes and only allowlisted low-cardinality scalar previews. The report has not demonstrated a secret leak. A blanket gitignore or evidence deletion would break cross-clone provenance and is not an accepted remedy.

## Reported reproduction

## Two defects, one reproduction

Running `git rebase`, hitting a conflict, and running `git rebase --abort` leaves behind merge-receipt state that outlives the operation it describes.

## 1. The receipt survives the abort

After `git rebase --abort`, the working tree is clean and the item is byte-identical to `HEAD`:

```
$ git diff --quiet HEAD -- .agents/pm/issues/pm-cli-website-nc0j.toon && echo identical
identical
```

No merge landed. But a `state: "pending"` receipt persists, recording three conflicting fields (`acceptance_criteria`, `description`, `status`) with full `retained`/`discarded` values, and it is enough to fail the gate:

```
$ pm health --check-only
ok: False
failed_because: ['merge_decisions_unreviewed:1', 'merge_receipt_evidence_invalid:1']
```

So an abandoned operation leaves a repository permanently red on a decision the operator explicitly abandoned. A receipt describes a merge that exists in no history and no working tree.

Expected: receipts written by a merge driver during an operation that is subsequently aborted should not remain pending — either tied to the resulting commit, or discarded with the rest of the aborted state.

## 2. The working-tree copy is not gitignored

The driver writes a second copy into the working tree, and it is untracked but **not ignored**:

```
$ git status --porcelain
?? .agents/pm/merge-receipts/f9067de4-bc6c-477a-99de-c415951b2064.json

$ git check-ignore -v .agents/pm/merge-receipts/f9067de4-...json
(no match — not ignored)
```

This is not a stale-template problem. A **fresh `pm init` on 2026.9.5** writes:

```
.agents/pm/runtime/
.agents/pm/search/*
.agents/pm/locks/
.agents/pm/transactions/
.agents/pm/checkpoints/
!.agents/pm/search/eval-queries.json
```

`merge-receipts/` is absent. Checked across four independent repositories including a newly initialised one: zero have it ignored.

### Why this matters

The documented convention for these trackers is to commit `.agents/pm/**` — every `.toon` together with its `history/*.jsonl`. An agent doing that with `git add -A` also commits the receipts. That:

- publishes receipt bodies containing the **full retained and discarded text** of every conflicting field, into repositories that may be public, and
- converts evidence the design treats as clone-local into tracked state, which changes what `merge_receipt_evidence_*` and the `tracked_runtime_cache_files` check mean. There is a guard for tracked runtime cache; there is none for tracked receipts.

Expected: `pm init` ignores `.agents/pm/merge-receipts/` alongside `runtime/`, `locks/`, `transactions/` and `checkpoints/`, and existing repositories get the entry on the next write to that directory. If receipts are instead *meant* to be committed, then the health check that treats them as clone-local evidence and the `pm init` template disagree, and the intended contract should be stated.

## Environment

@unbrained/pm-cli 2026.9.4 (writer) and 2026.9.5 (reader and `pm init` probe), Linux, Node 22.

## Delivery boundary

Intake only in PR #1204. This item remains open and unclaimed; no implementation or reproduction success is asserted. Implement through the public SDK with thin CLI adapters and executable negative controls before closing.
GH-1202: Classify abandoned merge receipts without losing durable provenance

Reproduce receipt lifecycle after an aborted rebase and distinguish an abandoned candidate from a merge requiring review. Current source and Merge Safety documentation intentionally track privacy-safe durable sidecars; raw free-form retained/discarded values are clone-local under .git. Durable receipts retain hashes and only allowlisted low-cardinality scalar previews. The report has not demonstrated a secret leak. A blanket gitignore or evidence deletion would break cross-clone provenance and is not an accepted remedy.

An actual conflicting rebase followed by abort has deterministic receipt classification and a supported recovery path; Recovery preserves immutable evidence and cannot dismiss an applied merge merely because a later snapshot differs; Fresh-clone tests prove tracked sidecars never contain arbitrary descriptions, acceptance text, or custom status values; CLI guidance clearly distinguishes clone-local raw receipts from intentionally tracked durable sidecars
Reduce recovery ambiguity and preserve trustworthy project context for agents
A reproducible SDK contract with actionable CLI recovery and regression evidence

value.author: harness:codex
value.text: Restored files alone do not prove an aborted Git operation. Capture original commit and blob coordinates during the rebase, then require inactive Git operation markers, matching HEAD, index and working blob, and a clean immutable history snapshot before appending an explicit abandonment audit.
